_about: Rows for assets/manifest.json of any game (same shape as the game-3d skill: name, path, source, author, licence, commercial, usedFor). Copy the rows of the figures you use; build.sh writes the files at these paths. scripts/characters.test.mjs checks every roster figure has a row.
